claim: Layang-Layang, Sabah Trough and Kinabalu Basin are three structural positions within one collision system (lower plate / foredeep / upper plate), not three independent basins.

One collision (COLLISION_MM), three opposite expressions: RU drowning without major erosion on the lower plate; foredeep onset in the trough; DRU uplift-erosion on the upper plate. They are physically different surfaces with different seismic signatures.
source: Arif ENTERPRISE relay + Clift et al. 2008 + Hinz 1985
confidence: MED-HIGH for order, LOW for exact age

claim: Rifted Dangerous Grounds crust continues SE beneath Neogene Borneo sediments at least halfway between the Sabah shelf and slope toe; part of Kinabalu is stacked above Layang-Layang crust at depth.
source: Arif ENTERPRISE relay 2026-09-30 (INTERPRET — untested by cross-trough dip line)

claim: SCS seafloor spreading terminated after ~16 Ma when the Dangerous Grounds collided with and jammed the Borneo trench; spreading onset ~33-32 Ma (C12) per IODP Exp 349.
source: Clift et al. 2008; IODP Expedition 349 results (public)

claim: Subduction polarity and timing beneath NW Borneo is unresolved: older SE-directed proto-SCS subduction vs newer continental underthrusting from ~base Miocene. HOLD; both recorded; do not average.
source: Arif ENTERPRISE relay 2026-09-30 + public literature debate
